calls.title: GrowthBook x ClickHouse — Experimentation & Feature Flag Enablement
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around key principles of user bucketing, emphasizing deterministic hashing for consistent variant assignments and the importance of using a traffic slider for safe rollout. Experimentation mechanics such as namespaces to prevent overlapping exposures were highlighted, along with GrowthBook’s data integration for analytics and flexible metric slicing. The group also examined handling complex use cases like conditional experiments and clustering across organizations, with emphasis on security provisions for feature flags and monitoring mechanisms. The meeting concluded with insights on internal team support, experiment tracking, and a commitment to addressing follow-up items for improved functionalities.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation, deterministic hashing, namespaces, cluster experiments, guardrail metrics
calls.action_items:

Provide additional documentation and information about conversion windows and look-back windows to Ally Godine for conditional experiment analysis needs (33:50)
Assist with further clarifications or demos on feature flag security options including encryption and remote evaluation per Allen’s questions (52:50)

**Cris Dizon**
Share documentation on guardrail metrics, ramp schedules, and monitoring features related to feature flag rollouts with ClickHouse team (56:20)
Explore more on cluster experiments in detail with ClickHouse to address their multi-org user exposure concerns and help define consistent treatment assignment (40:50)

**Allen Gilliland**
Coordinate internally and possibly with GrowthBook on governance and role-based controls for feature flags to enable broader team access with appropriate permissions (51:30)
Consider experimenting with Slack communication for quick issue resolutions and escalate to further calls if necessary for technical deep dives (52:00)

**Dani Sandoval**
Highlight internal use cases with feature flags and experimentation, especially around organizational targeting, to continue collaborative refinement with GrowthBook team (37:00)

**Cary Rakin**
